Name: Rainbow Frogs
Author: FableTheDragon
Description:
[size=4]This mod updates all the new pet frog sprites![/size]

You can now get frogs in red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple, void, and prismatic!
Some just got a slight tweak and others got a full recolor~
Frogs are still randomized, so you'll need to either get lucky or use a mod like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22358]Perfect Trinkets  [/url]to get the color you want!


This is my first proper Stardew mod, so please let me know if there is anything that needs fixed or improved!


[size=2]Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher [/url] ⭐[/size]

Manifest.Name: (CP) Rainbow Frogs
Manifest.Description: Updates the frog pets to be in different colors.
